description: This file defines a final class 'Locale' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the Style/NumberFormat/Wizard namespace. The class manages locale formatting for numbers, encapsulating the creation and validation of a NumberFormatter object and providing a method to retrieve the formatting pattern. It also defines a regex pattern to parse locale strings. The class interacts with external PHP classes such as NumberFormatter and PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Exception.

classes.name: Locale
classes.description: A final class providing locale-based number formatting functionality within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including validation and pattern retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Locale object with a given locale string and style, creating a NumberFormatter. Throws an exception if the formatter cannot be constructed or if the locale data cannot be read.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the pattern string for number formatting according to the set locale.
